XV.}}</noinclude>{{dropinitial|I|image=Rhemes New Testament 1582 initial I, foliage.png|imgsize=155px|fl={{verse|chapter=15|verse=1}}}} {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=The Gospel for one Martyr.}}{{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=The Gospel for one Martyr.}}AM the true vine: and my father is the husband-man. {{verse|chapter=15|verse=2}}† Euery {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=∷ Christ hath some branches in his body mystical that be fruitles. therfore il liuers also may be members of Christ & the Church.}}∷ branche in me, not bearing fruite, he wil take it avvay: and euery one that beareth fruite, he vvil purge it, {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=∷ Man may cōtinually increase in iustice and sanctification, so long as he liueth.}}∷ that it may bring more fruite. {{verse|chapter=15|verse=3}}† Novv you are cleane for the {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=∷ S. Augustine expoundeth it of the Sacramētal word of Baptisme, and not as Heretikes do, of preaching onely. ''Tract. 80. in Io''.}}∷ word vvhich I haue spoken to you. {{verse|chapter=15|verse=4}}† Abide in me: and I in you. As the branche can not beare fruite of it self, {{sup|‖}} vnles it abide in the vine: so you neither, {{sup|‖}} vnles you abide in me. {{verse|chapter=15|verse=5}}† I am the vine: you the branches. he that abideth in me, and I in him, the same beareth much fruite: for vvithout me you can doe nothing. {{verse|chapter=15|verse=6}}† If any abide not in me: he shal be cast forth as the branche, and shal vvither, and they shal gather him vp, and cast him into the fire, and he burneth. {{verse|chapter=15|verse=7}}† If you {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=∷ If a Schismatike pray neuer so much, he is not heard, because he remayneth not in the body of Christ.}}∷ abide in me, and my vvordes abide in you: you shal aske what thing soeuer you vvil, and it shal be done to you.⊣ {{verse|chapter=15|verse=8}}† In this my father is glorified: that you bring very much fruite, and become my Disciples. {{verse|chapter=15|verse=9}}† As my father hath loued me, I also haue loued you. Abide in my loue. {{verse|chapter=15|verse=10}}† If you {{sup|‖}} keepe my precepts, you shal abide in my loue: as I also haue kept my fathers precepts, and doe abide in his loue. {{verse|chapter=15|verse=11}}† These things I haue spoken to you, that my ioy may be in you, and your ioy may be filled. {{verse|chapter=15|verse=12}}† {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=''Io. 13, 34.''}}* This is my precept, that you loue one an other, as I haue loued you. {{verse|chapter=15|verse=13}}† {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=The Gospel vpō S. Barnabees day, and on the eue of an Apostle.}}Greater loue then this no man hath, that a man yeld his life for his frendes. {{verse|chapter=15|verse=14}}† You are my frendes, if you doe the things that I commaund you. {{verse|chapter=15|verse=15}}† Now I cal you not seruants: for the seruant knovveth not vvhat his lord doeth. But you I haue called frendes: because al things vvhatsoeuer I heard of my father, I haue notified vnto you. {{verse|chapter=15|verse=16}}† You chose not me, but I chose you: and haue appointed you: that you goe, & bring fruite: and your fruite abide: that vvhatsoeuer you aske the father in my name, he may giue it you.⊣ {{verse|chapter=15|verse=17}}† These things I commaund you, that you loue one an other.

{{verse|chapter=15|verse=18}}† {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=The Gospel vpō SS. Simon and Iudes day.}}If the vvorld hate you: know ye that it hath hated me before you. {{verse|chapter=15|verse=19}}† If you had been of the vvorld, the vvorld vvould loue his owne. but because you are not of the world, but I haue chosen you out of the vvorld, therfore the vvorld hateth you. {{verse|chapter=15|verse=20}}† Remembre my vvord that I said to you, {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=''Io. 13, 16. Mt. 10, 24. Lu. 6, 40.''}}* The seruant is not greater then his maister. If they haue persecuted me, you also vvil they persecute. if they haue kept my vvord, {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=∷ He foresheweth that many vvil not obey the Churches wordes, & no maruel, because they contemned Christes owne precepts.}}∷ yours also vvil they keepe. {{verse|chapter=15|verse=21}}† But al these things they vvil<noinclude>{{rh|||doe}}</noinclude>
